title: Great Rift & Lake Natron
framing: A northern Tanzania corridor linking inhabited Rift Valley landscapes, archaeology, Lake Natron, Ol Doinyo Lengai and onward safari country.

core_places.name: Engaruka
core_places.summary: An extensive abandoned irrigated and terraced agricultural landscape on the Rift floor, with field systems that developed over centuries.
core_places.fit: Adds historical depth to a route that might otherwise be read only as geology or wildlife.

core_places.name: Lake Natron
core_places.summary: A highly alkaline Rift Valley soda lake and Ramsar wetland, especially important as East Africa’s only regular breeding area for Lesser Flamingos.
core_places.fit: Best when the journey has enough time to treat Natron as a destination rather than a difficult transfer.

core_places.name: Ol Doinyo Lengai
core_places.summary: An active stratovolcano south of Lake Natron, known for its unusual carbonatite lavas and for its significance in Maasai culture.
core_places.fit: The mountain itself belongs in the landscape story; any ascent must remain conditional on current volcanic, route and local safety conditions.

core_places.name: Rift floor communities
core_places.summary: Pastoral and agricultural communities are part of the corridor itself, not an attraction added to it.
core_places.fit: Best approached through local guides and host-led encounters that make geographic and social sense.

decision_factors.label: Time
decision_factors.note: Natron makes most sense when it is given destination time, not inserted as a rushed transfer.

decision_factors.label: Road conditions
decision_factors.note: Rough-road time and seasonal conditions materially affect routing and comfort.

decision_factors.label: Heat
decision_factors.note: The Rift floor can be very hot; walking and activity timing matter.

decision_factors.label: Flamingos
decision_factors.note: Breeding and concentrations depend on ecological conditions; sightings are never guaranteed.

decision_factors.label: Lengai
decision_factors.note: The volcano is active. Climbing is conditional and must be assessed close to travel.

operated_evidence.label: July 2026 · five travellers
operated_evidence.relevance: Lake Natron became one of the strongest memories of a wider northern journey that had already included Kilimanjaro, Kibosho, Tarangire, Ngorongoro, Serengeti and Maasai country.

sources_note: Public copy should retain the distinction between verified geographic/ecological facts and Enkiama operational judgement.
